scenarios.name: Place an order
scenarios.reason:
Added Colombia Huila to the bag and proceeded to checkout.
Entered Ada Lovelace’s name, ada@example.com, 12 Rua Augusta, and Lisbon, then placed the order.
The order was confirmed as TS-7119, with €17.90 charged.

scenarios.name: Free shipping from €50
scenarios.reason:
Added House Espresso and Paper Filters to the bag as requested.
Opened the bag and confirmed shipping was €4.90 with a total of €49.40.
Pressed the + control next to Paper Filters once; shipping updated to Free and the total updated to €51.00.

scenarios.name: Promo code total
scenarios.reason: The applied lowercase code was rejected, so the required discount cannot be achieved.
scenarios.diagnosis: The promo-code check does not accept the required lowercase code. The entered value is shown as uppercase after typing, then the site says the code does not work instead of applying the discount.
scenarios.suggestion: Update promo-code handling so that the required lowercase code welcome10 is accepted and applies a −€9.10 discount, producing a €81.90 total.
